meta.name: add-imessage
meta.description: Add iMessage to NanoClaw — one channel, two backends. Local (this Mac's chat.db via the Chat SDK bridge; macOS + Full Disk Access) or Hosted iMessage (via photon.codes — native spectrum-ts with a device-login wizard; any OS, no Mac relay). Triggers on "add imessage", "connect imessage", "add photon", "imessage via photon", "native imessage".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 NanoClaw 连接 iMessage 通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在使用 NanoClaw 并希望接收 iMessage 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Connect iMessage to NanoClaw as a channel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use NanoClaw and want to receive iMessage messages.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把 iMessage 渠道接入 NanoClaw:复制并注册适配器,选择本地(macOS)或远程(Photon)模式配置凭据,重启服务,并用你的手机号或邮箱作为 iMessage 身份标识,之后 NanoClaw 就能收发 iMessage。
howto.when: 当你说“add imessage”“connect imessage”等触发词,或要求添加或连接 iMessage 时触发。

say.note: 触发技能,开始配置 iMessage 连接。

say.text: 用 Photon 远程连接 iMessage。
say.note: 选择远程模式,输入服务器和 API key。

say.text: 配置本地 iMessage,使用这台 Mac。
say.note: 选择本地模式,需授予完全磁盘访问权限。

howto.what_en: This skill wires iMessage into NanoClaw: copies and registers the adapter, installs the dependency, configures local or remote (Photon) credentials, restarts the service, asks for your handle. NanoClaw then can send/receive iMessages.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "add imessage", "connect imessage", or ask to add/connect iMessage.

say_en.note: Triggers the skill to start iMessage setup.
Picks remote mode, asks for server and API key.

say_en.text: Set up local iMessage on this Mac.
say_en.note: Picks local mode, needs Full Disk Access.
